comment: "PKI" and "Trust Architecture" are used inconsistently, with what appears to be duplicate labelling for the same element; PKI is also treated as synonymous with trust architecture, though PKI is only one possible implementation and does not represent every trust architecture a country may use.

citation.caption: Figure 3.3
citation.raw: §3.3 The reference architecture in practice p.50 l.172, Figure 3.3

public.text: "PKI" and "Trust Architecture" are used inconsistently, with what appears to be duplicate labelling for the same element; PKI is also treated as synonymous with trust architecture, though PKI is only one possible implementation and does not represent every trust architecture a country may use.
public.suggestedRevision: Standardise on a single term throughout either use "PKI" specifically where PKI is meant, or use the broader "Trust Architecture" where the concept is generic and remove the duplicate labelling in Figure 3.3.
